items.name: Catch me if you can
items.warning: This only makes their next challenge roll target you. You cannot use this if you cannot currently be assigned as a quest target (for example if you are Dominant). If they reroll, lose their quest, or never get a new roll, the item is wasted.

items.name: Release
items.warning: Removes all restraints from the target, including locked ones. Collars stay on. The item is consumed even if they were already free.
